(Currently amended) A method for treating an ocular condition, the method comprising: administering to the interior of an eye a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a [[macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC)]] __polypeptide macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC), wherein the polypeptide MAAC comprises bevacizumab,__ to a mammal suffering from an ocular condition, wherein the composition also comprises a viscosity inducing component __comprising hyaluronic acid__ in an amount effective to increase the viscosity of the composition to a viscosity at about 25 C. of [[at least about]] __at least__ 10 cps at a shear rate of about 0.1/second, wherein said viscosity inducing component is injectable into the vitreous of a mammalian eye without permanently diminishing visual acuity, __wherein the ocular condition comprises macular degeneration, and wherein the composition is administered to the interior of said eye by placement into the posterior segment of the eye through a 27-gauge needle.__

4. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a suspension.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein the MAAC comprises [[an agent selected from the group consisting of a nucleic acid (a oligonucleotide) and a polypeptide]] __a polypeptide__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein said MAAC comprises a protein.
